Card 89 S6 (backlog xnvwh5a). Adds `daemon-version.mjs migrate | unmigrate | plist`, a host-local enable file, a stable `repo.git` per clone, and the health-watch plist template on `current`.

## Tool
- migrate: refuses overlays, tracked dirt, an already-migrated clone, or a HEAD that cannot read the host-local enable file. Makes `<home>/<name>/repo.git`, moves state (rename + link back), builds and smokes v0, sets `current`, writes `settings.local.json`, swaps `<ws>/<name>` for a symlink to `current`, parks the old dir as `legacy-<stamp>`.
- unmigrate: swaps the legacy dir back and renames state back. Fixture round trip restores tree, state and clone key (test).
- plist: rewrites only ProgramArguments and WorkingDirectory, with a backup, or reverts from it.
- Versioned rebuild now fetches into `repo.git` when it exists; versions get the real `origin` URL.

## Live trial on wev-health-watch (operator "Go" 2026-10-08), UTC
- 11:42 precondition: daemon-overlay list = [] . Before: 99 lock-fight lines in 24 h (98 starved, 1 tick-in-progress).
- 11:42 first migrate refused: v0 smoke failed (state links dangling; origin url named the repo "repo"). Nothing was cut over. Fixed: state moves before the build; versions get the real origin; failed-smoke retry.
- 11:44 migrate OK (v0 20261008T114415Z-6a22c6aaf768, state 3 paths moved). 11:45 plist backup + rewrite (diff = the 2 path lines, env untouched), bootout/bootstrap OK.
- 11:45-11:48 no ticks logged. Cause (manual run): v0 was built from a main without the host-enable code, so it ran the old in-place rebuild ("not-on-main").
- 11:49 ROLLBACK: bootout, unmigrate, plist restored from backup, bootstrap. Watch logged "started" 11:49:01 (silent ~8 min, under the 10 min limit). No version switch happened.
- Added a migrate guard (refuse until HEAD has this code). Trial 2 follows once this PR is on main and the clone has synced.
